Game Overview

In Slap Kingdom, the core idea is straightforward: step into the uproarious world of Slap Kingdom, where combat unfolds with giant hand-powered hilarity. Master the art of timing and precision to deliver epic slaps, outmaneuver opponents, and rise as the ultimate Slap King in chaotic and comedic battles. Will you become a legend in this slapstick showdown?
